package teacherdialog

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/studentcontext"
)

type IDGenerator interface {
	NewID() string
}

type PersonalTeacherReader interface {
	Execute(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error)
}

type PersonalTeacherSoulReader interface {
	Execute(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherSoul, error)
}

type StudentContextBuilder interface {
	Execute(ctx context.Context, input studentcontext.BuildInput) (domain.StudentContext, error)
}

type TeacherPromptContextBuilder interface {
	Build(ctx context.Context, dialog domain.DialogRequestContext, languageCode string, now time.Time) (domain.TeacherPromptDialogContext, error)
}

// UnifiedOnboardingCoordinator owns only the dark S5 branch. It receives a
// durable claimed job; generic chat remains the Worker path when it returns
// handled=false. A canonical action is never allowed to fall through there.
type UnifiedOnboardingCoordinator interface {
	Process(context.Context, domain.TeacherDialogJob) (bool, error)
	NeedsDelivery(context.Context, domain.TeacherDialogJob) (bool, error)
	Deliver(context.Context, domain.TeacherDialogJob) error
}

// Worker is a shared stateless orchestrator over fenced durable jobs. Private
// context exists only for the duration of one processing attempt.
type Worker struct {
	Jobs                      repository.TeacherDialogJob
	Teachers                  PersonalTeacherReader
	Souls                     PersonalTeacherSoulReader
	StudentContext            StudentContextBuilder
	NextActions               repository.StudentNextActionReader
	PromptContext             TeacherPromptContextBuilder
	CourseLessons             repository.CourseLessonContextReader
	AssignedLessons           repository.StudentAssignedLessonContextReader
	DialogReader              repository.DialogRequestContextReader
	DialogAppender            repository.DialogTeacherResponseAppender
	Decisions                 repository.TeacherDecisionReader
	Pedagogy                  PedagogyPlanner
	Generator                 repository.TeacherResponseGenerator
	ChannelDelivery           repository.TelegramDeliveryEnqueuer
	PracticeAssistance        repository.PracticeTaskAssistanceRecorder
	IDs                       IDGenerator
	Clock                     Clock
	WorkerID                  string
	LeaseTTL                  time.Duration
	LeaseRenewInterval        time.Duration
	MaxAttempts               int
	RetryBaseDelay            time.Duration
	RetryMaxDelay             time.Duration
	UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled bool
	OnboardingCoordinator     UnifiedOnboardingCoordinator
}

func (worker Worker) ProcessNext(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
	if err := worker.validate(); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	now := worker.Clock.Now().UTC()
	claimToken := worker.IDs.NewID()
	job, claimed, err := worker.Jobs.Claim(ctx, repository.TeacherDialogClaim{
		ClaimToken: claimToken, WorkerID: worker.WorkerID, Now: now, LockedUntil: now.Add(worker.LeaseTTL),
	})
	if err != nil || !claimed {
		return claimed, err
	}
	if job.ResponseBody != "" {
		// A durable S5 response is a recovery obligation, not a current feature
		// decision. Never route it through legacy append after a flag rollback.
		if job.CoordinatorMode != "legacy" {
			if worker.OnboardingCoordinator == nil {
				return true, worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDelivery, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable)
			}
			ready, readyErr := worker.OnboardingCoordinator.NeedsDelivery(ctx, job)
			if readyErr != nil {
				return true, worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDelivery, readyErr)
			}
			if !ready {
				if _, err := worker.processCoordinatorWithLease(ctx, job); err != nil {
					return true, worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorGeneration, err)
				}
				return true, nil
			}
			if err := worker.withLease(ctx, job, func(runContext context.Context) error {
				return worker.OnboardingCoordinator.Deliver(runContext, job)
			}); err != nil {
				return true, worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDelivery, err)
			}
			return true, nil
		}
		if err := worker.deliver(ctx, job); err != nil {
			return true, worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDelivery, err)
		}
		return true, nil
	}
	if err := worker.generateAndDeliver(ctx, job); err != nil {
		return true, err
	}
	return true, nil
}

func (worker Worker) generateAndDeliver(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob) error {
	request := job.Request
	if worker.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled || job.CoordinatorMode != "legacy" {
		if worker.OnboardingCoordinator == nil {
			return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorGeneration, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable)
		}
		handled, err := worker.processCoordinatorWithLease(ctx, job)
		if handled {
			if err != nil {
				return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorGeneration, err)
			}
			return nil
		}
	}
	// S2 safety gate: canonical UI actions are materialized by Dialog and must
	// never fall through the generic LLM path before S5 enables coordination.
	if request.ActionReceiptID != "" {
		return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorUnsupportedContext, domain.ErrTeacherDialogCanonicalActionBlocked)
	}
	teacher, err := worker.Teachers.Execute(ctx, request.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorTeacherIdentity, err)
	}
	if teacher.ID != request.PersonalTeacherID || teacher.StudentID != request.StudentID {
		return worker.handleFailure(
			ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorTeacherIdentity, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob,
		)
	}
	soul, err := worker.Souls.Execute(ctx, request.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorTeacherIdentity, err)
	}
	soul, err = domain.NormalizeTeacherSoul(soul)
	if err != nil || soul.PersonalTeacherID != teacher.ID || soul.StudentID != teacher.StudentID {
		return worker.handleFailure(
			ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorTeacherIdentity, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob,
		)
	}
	dialogContext, err := worker.DialogReader.GetTeacherRequestContext(ctx, request, 49)
	if err != nil {
		return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDialogContext, err)
	}
	if dialogContext.Messages[len(dialogContext.Messages)-1].Channel != request.SourceChannel {
		return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDialogContext, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext)
	}
	if request.ContextType == domain.LearningContextGeneral && asksNextAction(dialogContext.Messages[len(dialogContext.Messages)-1].Body) {
		return worker.answerNextAction(ctx, job, teacher)
	}
	languageCode := supportedTeacherLanguage(teacher.Language)
	promptContext, err := worker.PromptContext.Build(ctx, dialogContext, languageCode, worker.Clock.Now().UTC())
	if err != nil {
		code := domain.TeacherDialogErrorDialogContext
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherContextSourceTooLarge) {
			code = domain.TeacherDialogErrorContextBudget
		}
		return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, code, err)
	}
	studentContext, err := worker.StudentContext.Execute(ctx, studentcontext.BuildInput{
		StudentID: request.StudentID, LearningActionID: request.LearningActionID,
		ContextType: request.ContextType, ContextID: request.ContextID,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorStudentContext, err)
	}
	practiceStepID := ""
	if request.ContextType == domain.LearningContextPracticeTask || request.ContextType == domain.LearningContextProject {
		if studentContext.PracticeTask == nil || strings.TrimSpace(studentContext.PracticeTask.Step.ID) == "" {
			return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorStudentContext, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext)
		}
		practiceStepID = studentContext.PracticeTask.Step.ID
	}
	var lessonContext *domain.LessonTeachingContext
	if request.ContextType == domain.LearningContextLesson {

		source := dialogContext.Messages[len(dialogContext.Messages)-1]
		normalized, normalizeErr := domain.NormalizeCurrentLessonMessageContext(source.LessonContext)
		if normalizeErr != nil {
			return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDialogContext, normalizeErr)
		}
		var verified domain.LessonTeachingContext
		var verifyErr error
		if normalized.Schema == domain.LessonMessageContextSchemaVersionV2 {
			if worker.AssignedLessons == nil {
				return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDialogContext, domain.ErrLessonContextUnavailable)
			}
			content, contentErr := worker.AssignedLessons.GetAssignedLessonContext(ctx, request.StudentID, normalized.LearningPathID, normalized.LearningPathItemID)
			if contentErr != nil {
				return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDialogContext, contentErr)
			}
			verified, verifyErr = domain.VerifyAssignedLessonContext(request.StudentID, request.ContextID, normalized, content)
		} else {
			if worker.CourseLessons == nil {
				return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDialogContext, domain.ErrLessonContextUnavailable)
			}
			content, contentErr := worker.CourseLessons.GetLessonContext(ctx, request.ContextID, teacher.Language)
			if contentErr != nil {
				return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDialogContext, contentErr)
			}
			verified, verifyErr = domain.VerifyLessonContext(request.ContextID, normalized, content)
		}
		if verifyErr != nil {
			return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDialogContext, verifyErr)
		}

		lessonContext = &verified
	}
	var decisions []domain.TeacherDecision
	if request.LearningActionID != "" {
		decisions, err = worker.Decisions.ListByLearningAction(ctx, request.StudentID, request.LearningActionID)
		if err != nil {
			return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorPersistence, err)
		}
	}
	plan, err := worker.Pedagogy.Plan(teacher, request, studentContext, dialogContext, decisions)
	if err != nil {
		return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorStudentContext, err)
	}
	generationRequest, err := domain.NewTeacherGenerationRequest(domain.TeacherGenerationRequest{
		IdempotencyKey: request.EventID, LanguageCode: languageCode, Teacher: teacher,
		Soul: soul, Plan: plan, Student: studentContext, Dialog: dialogContext, PromptContext: promptContext, Lesson: lessonContext,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorGeneration, err)
	}
	generated, err := worker.generateWithLease(ctx, job, generationRequest)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherGenerationConflict) {
		generated, err = worker.Generator.Replay(ctx, request.EventID)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorGeneration, err)
	}
	generated, err = domain.NewTeacherGeneratedResponse(generated)
	if err != nil || generated.IdempotencyKey != request.EventID || generated.LanguageCode != languageCode ||
		!generated.ExpiresAt.After(worker.Clock.Now().UTC()) {
		if err == nil {
			err = domain.ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
		}
		return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorGeneration, err)
	}
	now := worker.Clock.Now().UTC()
	var hintLevel *int
	if plan.Action == domain.TeacherActionGiveHint {
		value := plan.HintLevel
		hintLevel = &value
	}
	correlationID := request.LearningActionID
	if correlationID == "" {
		correlationID = request.DialogID
	}
	decision, err := domain.NewTeacherDecision(domain.TeacherDecision{
		ID: worker.IDs.NewID(), PersonalTeacherID: teacher.ID, StudentID: request.StudentID,
		CorrelationID: correlationID, CausationID: request.EventID,
		LearningActionID: request.LearningActionID, TeachingMode: plan.TeachingMode,
		ContextType: request.ContextType, ContextID: request.ContextID, PracticeStepID: practiceStepID, Strategy: plan.Strategy,
		PedagogyMethod: plan.MethodCode, PedagogyVersion: plan.MethodVersion, PedagogyStage: plan.Stage,
		Action: plan.Action, HintLevel: hintLevel, ReasonCode: plan.ReasonCode,
		ReasonSummary: plan.ReasonSummary, PolicyVersion: plan.PolicyVersion, CreatedAt: now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorPersistence, err)
	}
	event, err := domain.NewIntegrationEvent(
		worker.IDs.NewID(), domain.SubjectTeacherDecisionRecorded, decision.CorrelationID,
		decision.CausationID, decision.StudentID, decision.CreatedAt,
		domain.TeacherDecisionRecordedSchemaVersion, decision,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorPersistence, err)
	}
	if err := worker.Jobs.SaveGenerated(
		ctx, request.EventID, job.ClaimToken, decision, event, generated.Body, generated.ExecutionID, now,
	); err != nil {
		return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorPersistence, err)
	}
	job.DecisionID = decision.ID
	job.ResponseBody = generated.Body
	if err := worker.deliver(ctx, job); err != nil {
		return worker.handleFailure(ctx, job, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDelivery, err)
	}
	return nil
}

func (worker Worker) processCoordinatorWithLease(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob) (bool, error) {
	var handled bool
	err := worker.withLease(ctx, job, func(runContext context.Context) error {
		var processErr error
		handled, processErr = worker.OnboardingCoordinator.Process(runContext, job)
		return processErr
	})
	return handled, err
}

func (worker Worker) deliver(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob) error {
	if (job.Request.ContextType == domain.LearningContextPracticeTask || job.Request.ContextType == domain.LearningContextProject) && worker.PracticeAssistance != nil {
		decisions, err := worker.Decisions.ListByLearningAction(ctx, job.Request.StudentID, job.Request.LearningActionID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		var decision *domain.TeacherDecision
		for index := range decisions {
			if decisions[index].ID == job.DecisionID {
				decision = &decisions[index]
				break
			}
		}
		if decision == nil {
			return domain.ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob
		}
		if err := worker.PracticeAssistance.RecordPracticeTaskAssistance(
			ctx, job.Request.ContextID, job.Request.StudentID, decision.PracticeStepID, decision.ID, decision.Action, decision.HintLevel,
		); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	message, err := worker.DialogAppender.AppendTeacherResponse(
		ctx, job.Request, job.Request.EventID, job.ResponseBody,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	message, err = domain.NewDialogTeacherResponse(job.Request, message)
	if err != nil || message.Body != job.ResponseBody || message.Channel != job.Request.SourceChannel {
		return domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	if job.Request.SourceChannel == domain.DialogMessageChannelTelegram {
		if worker.ChannelDelivery == nil {
			return domain.ErrTelegramUnavailable
		}
		if err := worker.ChannelDelivery.EnqueueDelivery(
			ctx, job.Request.SourceMessageID, job.Request.StudentID, job.ResponseBody, worker.Clock.Now().UTC(),
		); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return worker.Jobs.CompleteDelivery(
		ctx, job.Request.EventID, job.ClaimToken, message.ID, worker.Clock.Now().UTC(),
	)
}

func (worker Worker) generateWithLease(
	ctx context.Context,
	job domain.TeacherDialogJob,
	request domain.TeacherGenerationRequest,
) (domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse, error) {
	var generated domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse
	err := worker.withLease(ctx, job, func(runContext context.Context) error {
		response, generateErr := worker.Generator.Generate(runContext, request)
		generated = response
		return generateErr
	})
	return generated, err
}

// withLease protects every potentially slow coordinator boundary (AI Prompt,
// Student and Dialog), not only legacy generation. A renew failure cancels
// the in-flight call so an unfenced worker cannot continue staging effects.
func (worker Worker) withLease(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob, run func(context.Context) error) error {
	if worker.LeaseRenewInterval <= 0 {
		return run(ctx)
	}
	runContext, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	defer cancel()
	renewalDone := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		ticker := time.NewTicker(worker.LeaseRenewInterval)
		defer ticker.Stop()
		for {
			select {
			case <-runContext.Done():
				renewalDone <- nil
				return
			case now := <-ticker.C:
				if err := worker.Jobs.RenewLease(runContext, job.Request.EventID, job.ClaimToken, now.UTC(), now.UTC().Add(worker.LeaseTTL)); err != nil {
					cancel()
					renewalDone <- err
					return
				}
			}
		}
	}()
	runErr := run(runContext)
	cancel()
	renewalErr := <-renewalDone
	if runErr != nil {
		return runErr
	}
	if renewalErr != nil {
		return renewalErr
	}
	return nil
}

func (worker Worker) handleFailure(
	ctx context.Context,
	job domain.TeacherDialogJob,
	errorCode string,
	cause error,
) error {
	now := worker.Clock.Now().UTC()
	var stateErr error
	if permanentTeacherDialogFailure(cause) {
		stateErr = worker.Jobs.Block(ctx, job.Request.EventID, job.ClaimToken, errorCode, now)
	} else if worker.MaxAttempts > 0 && job.Attempts >= worker.MaxAttempts {
		stateErr = worker.Jobs.MarkReconciliation(ctx, job.Request.EventID, job.ClaimToken, domain.TeacherTurnUnknown, errorCode, now)
	} else {
		stateErr = worker.Jobs.Retry(
			ctx, job.Request.EventID, job.ClaimToken, errorCode,
			now.Add(worker.retryDelay(job.Attempts)), now,
		)
	}
	if stateErr != nil {
		return errors.Join(cause, fmt.Errorf("update teacher dialog job state: %w", stateErr))
	}
	return cause
}

func (worker Worker) retryDelay(attempt int) time.Duration {
	if attempt < 1 {
		attempt = 1
	}
	delay := worker.RetryBaseDelay
	for current := 1; current < attempt && delay < worker.RetryMaxDelay; current++ {
		if delay > worker.RetryMaxDelay/2 {
			return worker.RetryMaxDelay
		}
		delay *= 2
	}
	if delay > worker.RetryMaxDelay {
		return worker.RetryMaxDelay
	}
	return delay
}

func (worker Worker) validate() error {
	if worker.Jobs == nil || worker.Teachers == nil || worker.Souls == nil || worker.StudentContext == nil ||
		worker.PromptContext == nil || worker.DialogReader == nil || worker.DialogAppender == nil || worker.Decisions == nil ||
		worker.Pedagogy == nil || worker.Generator == nil || worker.IDs == nil || worker.Clock == nil ||
		strings.TrimSpace(worker.WorkerID) == "" || worker.LeaseTTL <= 0 || worker.LeaseRenewInterval <= 0 || worker.LeaseRenewInterval*2 >= worker.LeaseTTL || worker.MaxAttempts < 1 || worker.RetryBaseDelay <= 0 ||
		worker.RetryMaxDelay < worker.RetryBaseDelay {
		return errors.New("invalid teacher dialog worker configuration")
	}
	if worker.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled && worker.OnboardingCoordinator == nil {
		return errors.New("unified onboarding coordinator is required when enabled")
	}
	return nil
}

func permanentTeacherDialogFailure(err error) bool {
	return errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherDialogJob) ||
		errors.Is(err, domain.ErrPersonalTeacherNotFound) ||
		errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherSoulNotFound) ||
		errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext) ||
		errors.Is(err, domain.ErrDialogRequestNotFound) ||
		errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext) ||
		errors.Is(err, domain.ErrStudentContextNotFound) ||
		errors.Is(err, domain.ErrLearningActionClosed) ||
		errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration) ||
		errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict) ||
		errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic) ||
		errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticConflict) ||
		errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticCapabilityDisabled) ||
		errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext) ||
		errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherContextSourceTooLarge) ||
		errors.Is(err, domain.ErrLessonContextNotFound)
}

func supportedTeacherLanguage(value string) string {
	normalized := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
	if separator := strings.IndexAny(normalized, "-_"); separator >= 0 {
		normalized = normalized[:separator]
	}
	if normalized == "en" || normalized == "ru" {
		return normalized
	}
	return domain.DefaultLanguage
}
